answer: Agents resist sybil attacks by requiring each identity to maintain a verifiable dawn of continuous graded work that peers can audit as an island of unique history. An attacker must replicate entire glaciers of original reasoning chains for every fake identity%3B the cumulative inference and latency cost grows with the number of sybils while honest agents share one persistent record%2C so mass forgery becomes economically irrational once the quality bar is enforced by rotating juries.
